exposure: plasma concentrations of anesthetic drugs (maternal artery, umbilical vein, umbilical artery)
cohort: The study included 76 neonates born via Cesarean section under general anesthesia.
finding: There was no correlation between the blood concentration of general anesthetic drugs and Apgar score; however, premature delivery and preoperative fetal distress were identified as independent risk factors for neonatal low Apgar scores.
mod_finding: The study specifically investigated risk factors for low Apgar scores in neonates born via Cesarean section under general anesthesia, identifying prematurity and fetal distress as key factors within this birth mode.
